title: GitHub - puffinsoft/mousecrack: Bypass agent cursor detection with deep learning.
excerpt: Bypass agent cursor detection with deep learning. Contribute to puffinsoft/mousecrack development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Synthesize organically varied, human-like mouse movement.

This project aims to test the abilities of deep-learning for mouse imitation.

See it in Action

demo.mp4

Clearly, it's not perfect. But this is v0.1.0. Still a lot of fun stuff to try on the model side :).

Installation

npm i -g mousecrack

Usage

Warning

This project is still experimental! For educational purposes only.

Available as an SDK (for developers) and CLI (for agents).

SDK

import { move, steps } from 'mousecrack';

await move(200, 400);

// or alternatively...
const from = { x: 100, y: 200 }
const to = { x: 200, y: 400 }
await steps(from, to);

// [
//   { x: 100, y: 200, t: 0 },
//   { x: 95, y: 202, t: 10.528131778472712 },
//   { x: 90, y: 210, t: 21.040190062833986 },
//   { x: 81, y: 223, t: 31.892832399406224 },
//   ...

CLI

mousecrack move 200 400 # (x, y)
mousecrack steps 100 200 200 400 # from (x, y), to (x, y)
Install the Skill

For Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add puffinsoft/mousecrack
/plugin install move-mouse@mousecrack

For Codex:

codex plugin marketplace add puffinsoft/mousecrack
codex plugin add move-mouse@mousecrack

How does it work?

Mousecrack treats mouse prediction like a time forecasting problem.

It models mouse movement as a change in position (dx, dy) and time (dt), and tries to predict the next step in this multivariate time series.

To avoid the mode collapse problem, Mousecrack uses a Mixture Density Network to model several trajectories as a probability distribution.

Mousecrack is open source software, licensed under the MIT license.

content_html_zh:
合成有机变化的、类似人类的鼠标运动。

该项目旨在测试深度学习模仿小鼠的能力。

查看实际操作

demo.mp4

显然，它并不完美。 但这是v0.1.0。 在模型方面还有很多有趣的东西可以尝试:)。

安装

npm i -g mousecrack

Usage

警告

该项目仍处于实验阶段！ 仅用于教育目的。

以 SDK（针对开发人员）和 CLI（针对代理）的形式提供。

SDK

import { move, steps } from 'mousecrack';

await move(200, 400);

// or alternatively...
const from = { x: 100, y: 200 }
const to = { x: 200, y: 400 }
await steps(from, to);

// [
//   { x: 100, y: 200, t: 0 },
//   { x: 95, y: 202, t: 10.528131778472712 },
//   { x: 90, y: 210, t: 21.040190062833986 },
//   { x: 81, y: 223, t: 31.892832399406224 },
//   ...

CLI

mousecrack move 200 400 # (x, y)
mousecrack steps 100 200 200 400 # from (x, y), to (x, y)
Install the Skill

对于克劳德代码：

/plugin marketplace add puffinsoft/mousecrack
/plugin install move-mouse@mousecrack

对于法典：

codex plugin marketplace add puffinsoft/mousecrack
codex plugin add move-mouse@mousecrack

它是如何运作的？

Mousecrack 将鼠标预测视为时间预测问题。

它将鼠标移动建模为位置 (dx, dy) 和时间 (dt) 的变化，并尝试预测该多元时间序列中的下一步。

为了避免模式崩溃问题，Mousecrack 使用混合密度网络将多个轨迹建模为概率分布。

Mousecrack 是开源软件，根据 MIT 许可证获得许可。
